items.title: Mike Wofford interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: And then shortly thereafter I worked with Shorty Rogers and his Giants which was a very well known band in those days.

ctx.x: Right. What was the first important gig that, if you look back on it now, was there a series of gigs?

Probably — I worked at The Lighthouse, which was a really famous club and really an institution, in Hermosa Beach which is just south of Los Angeles on the coast there. It was called The Lighthouse All-Stars was the band. Howard Rumsey, who lives near here by the way now, in Hemet, which is a city about an hour and a half from San Diego, he had a wonderful band there, a house band there, I’m sure you’re familiar with The Lighthouse, and I was fortunate enough to play in that band for a few months in the — it…
Did the players, like Shorty Rogers and yourself, did you consider that you were playing the west coast sound, or was that something that the east coast people put on your music?
